notes.title: Castle of Shikigami - Major (free!) Update
notes.notes:
The team has been working hard on improving the game and thanks to your feedback we have a large update to release today. The details are below, but we still have more to come, so stay tuned!

Update Details

Added Slowdown option
Accessed via the Options, this can be turned on or off. The slowdown is as close as we can get to the original console releases, but will vary depending on your PC.
Added Practice Mode
Accessed via the main menu. New stages are opened once you've reached them in the main game. Each character's practice stages are independent, so unlocking stages for one character will not unlock them for the others. Scores are local only.
Fixed leaderboard issues
Without getting into technical discussions, the problem here is that Shikigami's scores are larger than Steam's leaderboards can cope with, so the approach we took was to divide the scores uploaded to Steam by 10, while leaving the in-game scores faithful to the original game.
Changed Extend scores to match original game
Very Easy: First 100,000,000 and every further 100,000,000 points
Easy: First 100,000,000 and every further 200,000,000 points
Normal: First 150,000,000 and every further 300,000,000 points
Hard: First 200,000,000 and every further 400,000,000 points
Very Hard: First 250,000,000 and every further 400,000,000 points


As always, if you have any issues post-update, please post them here.

Thanks, the Shikigami team.

notes.title: Castle of Shikigami: Major update on the way!
notes.notes:
The Shikigami team have been busy working on an update to address some of the requests and issues we've been receiving from all of you. It's being tested at the moment, so we hope to bring you some good news soon.

However, as it effects the way the scoring system works and overall game difficulty, we will need to reset or renew the leaderboards when it launches. We don't make the decision lightly, but its neccessary in order to provide an even better gaming experience to you all.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28918383/a54a11695b362479de570c3843865b89083df218.jpg

Thanks, the Shikigami team.

notes.title: Castle of Shikigami release & hi-score contest
notes.notes:
Summer, 	[strike]July[/strike] June [strike]2005[/strike]2017 .

A shooting game is released from the steamy Summer streets of Tokyo.
That's right, it's time to call the paranormal investigators, because Castle of Shikigami is out now. And to celebrate, we have a hi-score contest!

Rules:
[olist]
Leave difficulty on default setting (Normal)
Play the game until you defeat Miyoko Aku, boss of stage 1-3
At the stage result screen, press F12 to take a screen capture
Post the capture to Twitter during the contest period with the official hashtag #castleofshikigami and a mention to us (@degigames)
edit: Multiple entries OK, but only one score per user will be accepted. 
[/olist]

If you can't locate the screen captures, open your Steam Library, right click on Castle of Shikigami and select 'View Screenshots' and follow the prompts to navigate to the correct folder.

Result screen:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28918383/ddbb30f589ad395f82c8c1c4e9f18777c8c38ff7.png

Contest Dates:
Start: June 15th (Thursday)
Finish: 7pm PT on June 25th (Sunday)

Prizes:
1st place: A Shikigami poster & the soundtrack (Steam key)
2nd place: A Shikigami poster
3rd place: The soundtrack (Steam key)

We'll also be picking two random winners and awarding them a prize too.

Poster:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28918383/9013d22c3d5421de763110898cbf7fffa703733d.jpg

Small Print
In order to deliver prizes, we will need to be able to contact you by email, so please check back at the end of the contest.
In order to send the posters, we will need a postal address and name.

Good Luck!
